items.q: How do I buy the POS system?
items.a: Try the free version first from the download page. When ready, order the full version on the site — we confirm on WhatsApp, you pay however suits you (Instapay / Vodafone Cash / transfer), then we send the installer and your activation code.

items.q: What are the activation code and machine code?
items.a: After installing the full version, the app shows your PC's machine code. Send it to us on WhatsApp and we reply with an activation code bound to your device — paste it once and the app runs fully offline forever.

items.q: Is there a monthly subscription for the POS?
items.a: No — the full version is a one-time payment with a perpetual license. Optional yearly support & updates packages exist if you want them.

items.q: Does the system work without internet?
items.a: Yes, it is designed to run 100% offline with your data on your machine. Internet is only needed for optional features like WhatsApp campaigns.

items.q: What happens after I order an online store?
items.a: We contact you within hours, collect products and identity, and launch your store within days — Arabic storefront, payment gateway, and a full dashboard.
Clear monthly packages (excluding the paid ad budget that goes to Meta). Start small and scale — no long contracts.

items.q: What shop types do you work with?
items.a: The POS supports 10 shop types: restaurants, gold, mobiles, pharmacies, clothing, repair and more — same for stores and marketing: we tailor to your field.
Yes — Arabic support on WhatsApp and continuous updates. We use the same systems in our own shops, so keeping them excellent is our own interest.

sections.p: When you place an order or a project brief we store your name, contact method and order details so we can serve you. We do not collect personal browsing data or sell your data to anyone.
We use your data only to contact you about your order and to provide the service and support.
Data is stored securely with access limited to our team. You can request deletion anytime via WhatsApp or email.
For any privacy question, reach us via WhatsApp or the email on the contact page.
We provide digital marketing, POS systems, and e-commerce stores. Each service's details and price are confirmed in writing (WhatsApp) before work starts.
Ordering on the site reserves your spot with no online payment. Payment is agreed (Instapay / Vodafone Cash / bank transfer), after which delivery or activation begins.
The POS full-version license is perpetual and bound to one device. Moving it to a new device is available by contacting us.
The free trial exists so you can test before buying. After activation, refunds are evaluated case-by-case within 14 days.
All designs and systems remain property of ElHegazi Company until full payment, after which the agreed usage rights transfer to the client.
